title: The glymphatic–lymphatic axis: known pathways, open questions, and emerging roles in neurodegeneration
title_zh: 脑淋巴–淋巴轴：已知通路、未解问题与神经退行性疾病中新兴作用
abstract: Abstract The discovery of the glymphatic system and meningeal lymphatic vessels has transformed our understanding of brain fluid homeostasis and central–peripheral communication, highlighting the critical role of cerebrospinal fluid in brain clearance. While substantial progress has been made in defining the structural components and physiological regulators of brain clearance, major uncertainties remain regarding (1) how these systems interact as an integrated physiological network, (2) how they fail in disease, and (3) whether they can be therapeutically manipulated. In this review, we first summarize the anatomical and physiological organization of the glymphatic–lymphatic axis, with particular emphasis on its regulatory mechanisms in light of rapid advances in this field. We then discuss how the glymphatic–lymphatic axis functionally integrates with peripheral immune and metabolic systems and describe how impairment of these clearance pathways is associated with the accumulation of pathological proteins, neuroinflammation, and vascular dysfunction and may contribute to the progression of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s diseases. Finally, we discuss emerging therapeutic strategies and biomarkers targeting the glymphatic–lymphatic axis. By redefining the central–peripheral crosstalk, the glymphatic–lymphatic axis provides a unifying framework for understanding brain clearance, neurodegeneration, and future therapeutic interventions.
abstract_zh: 摘要：脑淋巴系统与脑膜淋巴血管的发现彻底改变了我们对脑液体稳态和中外通讯的理解，凸显脑脊液在脑清除中的关键作用。虽然在阐明脑清除的结构成分和生理调控方面已取得显著进展，但仍存在以下主要不确定性：（1）这些系统如何作为一个整体生理网络相互作用；（2）它们在疾病中的失效机制；（3）是否可以通过治疗手段进行调控。本文首先综述脑淋巴–淋巴轴的解剖与生理组织，重点讨论其调控机制，结合该领域的快速进展。随后讨论脑淋巴–淋巴轴如何与外周免疫和代谢系统功能整合，并描述这些清除通路受损与病理蛋白积聚、神经炎症、血管功能障碍的关联，以及它们如何促成阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病的进展。最后，探讨针对脑淋巴–淋巴轴的新兴治疗策略和生物标志物。通过重新定义中外交互，脑淋巴–淋巴轴为理解脑清除、神经退行性疾病及未来治疗干预提供了统一框架。
